tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Brand hue, a deep wine red. The main accent: primary actions, the active tab, the selected outline, the logo's dot. White text on it (6:1).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Second brand hue, an old gold. Links, the focus ring and small highlights; on background, card and popover (6.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: heather
tokens.usage: Data only: chart series.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Data only: chart series.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Data only: chart series and success marks.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (shadcn --background). Near-black with a faint violet bias.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on background, card, popover and muted (13:1 or better).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tool sidebars and inspectors on background.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs. Always with `border` and `shadow-pop`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: segmented control track, empty states, code blocks, progress track.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata; on background, card, muted and popover (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main action on a screen: primary Button, on Switch, checked Checkbox, active Tab underline, selected outline. One per view.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (6:1).

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Oxblood as text, lightened to read on dark: active nav item, overlines; on background and card (7:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button, selected rows in lists and sidebars. A faint warm tint.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted items in menus, lists, command palettes (shadcn --accent).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Tag and chip fills.

tokens.name: tag-foreground
tokens.usage: Tag text on tag (8.4:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on background and card; underlined.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete and irreversible actions. A lighter vermilion so it never looks like the oxblood primary; dark `destructive-foreground` text on it. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive (5.7:1).

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Destructive menu items and error messages as text, on card and popover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, exported states as text on background and card, with a check icon.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions, card and table borders (decorative).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; 3:1 or better on background and card.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset (8:1 on background). Brass so focus never reads as the oxblood primary.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth data series.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The wordmark only. Lowercase; the period in `primary`. On a tool or sub-site, the product name follows the period in `muted-foreground`: mostlymaking.references.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on the main site and a tool's landing view. Once per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, panel headers, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop images here to start a new board.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, dense tool UI (inspectors, toolbars).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase panel labels and overlines. Set in uppercase; never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Coordinates, dimensions, EXIF, file names, keyboard shortcuts. Tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, inside dense toolbars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; input inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters between cards, form row gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, small icon buttons, inputs in dense tool UI.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, cards. Matches shadcn --radius: 0.625rem.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, image tiles on the main site.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, status dots, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts. Cards stay flat with a border.
